name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn. Come to think of it, you haven't thrown out that thing in the closet yet, right.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The stuff you said you got from Tame-san at 'Ponpoko'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that playing with fire that goes boom and crackle.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's nothing like that--it's something much prettier and lovelier.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ama~zing. Your house really has everything, doesn't it, Synn-kun~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's all do them together, the fireworks!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't sweat it, don't sweat it. As long as they light, it'll be fine!」

name: Synn
message: 「No... Sasami should already be asleep, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「S-S-Senpai! There's no way something like that exists!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ju~st kidding. U-fu-fu\s04 It's a joke, a joke♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo-chan. It's fine, so stop hiding and come on out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaah, Lolotte and Senpai. If you cling to me that tight, aaaah.」

name: Ria
message: 「Truth is, I can't handle ghosts at all~~!」
Tug, tug--his sleeve is pulled timidly.

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Nothing. More importantly, take a good look. That's not a ghost.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What the heck. It's just a demon. Don't scare me like that.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I did my best... I really did. That didn't count as losing.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, now that the problem's taken care of, wanna set off some fireworks?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「They're chowing down on the loofah, but could that possibly taste good?」

name: Ria
message: 「Even though it's way too tough to eat raw...」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, could the culprit who's been trashing the garden actually be...」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right! So it wasn't Sasami after all--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Trashing Synn's house of all places--that's both ruthless and stupid.」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's just following its own desires, man.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, Sasami. I'll give you some milk later to make up for it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know, facing a Demon... doesn't it feel like we're losing our sense of tension?」

name: Ria
message: 「That just proves we're getting used to it.」

name: Paqy
message: 「This is no time to be getting dizzy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah! A grudge over food is terrifying. Prepare yourself!」
